about: Each state's CCDF initial income eligibility limit for a family of three, in dollars a month, as state law a legislature can change. 50 states and D.C. from the ACF Office of Child Care table (Colorado is its most populous county only; several states raised limits after Jan 2025 per NWLC, 'Warning Signs: State Child Care Assistance Policies 2025', May 2026, https://nwlc.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/State-of-Child-Care-2026-FINAL-WEB.pdf). Territories from their own plans; American Samoa, the Northern Marianas, the Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico are ESTIMATED (older, dated or draft sources).
